name: sqlnbfmt
description: Format SQL queries in Jupyter notebooks and Python files using sqlnbfmt

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, the workspace's sqlnbfmt.path setting is ignored, so an untrusted folder can't choose the program that runs.

sqlnbfmt.path.description: The sqlnbfmt executable: a command on PATH, or a path. Relative paths (e.g. .venv/bin/sqlnbfmt) and ${workspaceFolder} are resolved against the workspace folder.

sqlnbfmt.dialect.description: SQL dialect passed as --dialect (e.g. postgres, mysql, bigquery, duckdb). Leave empty to use the dialect configured in pyproject.toml or the config file; without one, generic SQL is used.

sqlnbfmt.configFile.description: A sqlnbfmt config file: YAML, or a TOML file with a [tool.sqlnbfmt] table. Relative paths and ${workspaceFolder} are resolved against the workspace folder. Leave empty to use [tool.sqlnbfmt] from the nearest pyproject.toml above the formatted file.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node out-test/test/e2e/runTest.js
